snippet.title: Rogue Voltage - 1.0 Announcement Trailer - Launching May 1st
snippet.description:
Rogue Voltage is the engineering roguelike.

Construct your combos by wiring circuits. Build crazy machines to zap the monsters and trigger satisfying chain reactions. Discover devastating synergies and create overpowered builds.

Rogue Voltage's unique wiring game mechanics are inspired by modular synthesizers and a novel twist on roguelike deckbuilder genre.

Rogue Voltage launches May 1st on Steam after 2 years of Early Access (93% positive)

🎛️ Wire up 170 unique modules
🔌 Construct crazy machines
💥 Game-breaking combos
⚡️ Satisfying chain reactions

Steam Page: https://s.team/a/1494560
Press Kit: https://horizontcomputergrafik.com/#roguevoltage
Discord: https://discord.gg/bGpnfJFUPj
